high_level_description: This black-and-white image captures a lively and festive moment at what appears to be a birthday celebration. Two women are the focal point of the photo, standing close together and smiling warmly at each other. The woman on the left has long, wavy hair and is wearing a white blouse with puffed sleeves and black pants. The woman on the right has long, blonde, wavy hair and is dressed in a sparkly black dress with long sleeves. The background features a decorative setup with large, metallic letter balloons spelling out "HAPPY BIRTHDAY.
